comment: Editor's picks for the weird-news front page (lib/weird.js). They are shown first, newest first, and stop showing 21 days after 'published' (a date, shown as noon UTC so it reads as the right day everywhere). Each pick links to the outlet's story and shows its headline exactly as the outlet wrote it. rating (1-5) and note (one line) are the owner's own words: never filled in by anyone else. 'seeded': true means the build team put the pick here from the designer's verified search and the owner has not reviewed it yet; seeded picks go through every moderation rule, so a pick that trips a hold rule is not shown. When the owner has reviewed a pick, set 'seeded' to false (the hold rules then defer to the owner's decision; the drop rules for sexual content and children with crime still apply). 'video': true only where the outlet's own headline says the story is a video. A pick has no picture unless the outlet's feed carries the same story with one.
